description: comptage du trafic CUB is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by NosCandidats -. In 2010 - road flow at peak hours 2009-2010: counting, average and evolution. In 2011 - road flow at peak hours 2010-2011: counting, average and evolution. The Urban Community of Bordeaux has installed a network of sensors to assess the state of traffic on its territory. Coverage: Communauté urbaine de Bordeaux. The portal shows the English title as "CUB Traffic Counting" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is NosCandidats -. Its keywords include circulation, routes, transport. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2016-01-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
